calls.reason: CNBC's reported ~$5B 2024 loss estimate fits the loss part, but SoftBank's up-to-$40B commitment undercuts the claim that OpenAI specifically needed more Microsoft money to survive.
Salesforce's Q4 FY25 earnings call reports over 3,000 paid Agentforce deals in the quarter, which contradicts 'doesn't make any money'; 'it sucks' is opinion.

Google's own posts show Gemini replacing classic Assistant and Gemini 2.5 powering AI Overviews in Search; reporting says AI Overviews had no off setting. A per-search Web filter only softens 'no choice'.
A sweeping causal claim about every tech bubble; the packet has no inventory of bubbles, and the one study, on the Railway Mania, found the media mainly supplied factual information.
McKinsey found most firms saw no material profit impact from gen AI, but also reported business-unit savings; nothing matches returns to capital, and 'meager' is evaluative.
The $315M loss and 420% growth are confirmed, but insufficient capex funding isn't shown given the expanded credit facility, and shares falling 7% after the call cut against 'doesn't matter'.
